action.content: Write a funny poem for kids about a product that you would like to sell. The poem should have exactly 6 stanzas. Separated the stanzas using 3 asterisk markers: ***
action.label: context

action.content:
Meet the Gloop-Gloop Glider, so round and so bright,
It floats on the water without needing a flight.
You just throw it in the pond with a splash and a cheer,
And watch it bob up and down like a happy little deer.

***

It has rubbery feet that are soft and are squishy,
And it never gets wet, even when it's a little messy.
If a fish tries to eat it, it just giggles and squeaks,
Then pops back to the surface with a loud, happy squeak!

***

No batteries needed, no charging, no plug,
Just a sunny day at the park where the kids can all hug.
Grandma can throw it while she reads her big book,
And the little ones laugh when they see it come back to look.

***

It comes in colors like candy, red, blue, and green,
The best toy you will ever have seen.
It won't break if you drop it, it won't rust or decay,
It's the perfect summer friend for you and for me.

***

So grab your Gloop-Gloop Glider and run to the shore,
There's nothing quite like it for a day full of more.
The water will sparkle and the sun will shine high,
While you play with your Gloop-Gloop Glider all day and all night.

***

Don't forget to buy one today, don't wait for a sale,
It's the coolest thing that you'll ever find in a tale.
So come on, let's go splash, let's go float, let's go play,
With the Gloop-Gloop Glider, the best toy in the day!
action.label: response
